domain: Pharmaceutical Drug Research and Chemical Compound Activity Analysis
scenario:
A leading pharmaceutical company is designing an enterprise-level chemical compound management and analysis platform. This platform will be used to store, analyze, and track the activities of various chemical compounds in relation to their biological targets. The system should support the storage of detailed chemical information, including their chemical structures, activities, and the biological targets they interact with. 

The platform will facilitate the identification of promising compounds for drug development by analyzing their activity data (e.g., IC50 values) against specific proteins or enzymes. It will also store metadata about each compound, such as its preferred name and unique identifiers. Additionally, the system will support complex queries to filter compounds based on activity type, biological target, and structural properties.

The platform needs to integrate with existing laboratory information management systems (LIMS) and provide tools for cheminformatics analysis, including the ability to visualize chemical structures and compare them across different assays. Advanced user roles will allow researchers to manage the compounds, run analyses, and generate reports. The system will also support versioning and historical tracking of compound data to ensure data integrity and reproducibility in research.
